SETUP TOOL
Craft Elevator Setup Tool. Hold it, aim at a placed block (wood through steel, not dirt), hold E.
New Ped Lift or New Vehicle Lift always starts a NEW lift.
Use Lift Here if you have more than one.
Corner 1 and Corner 2 = opposite corners. Ped: the whole cabin. Vehicle: the floor slab only, both corners the same height.
Add Floor: park the car at that landing first, then aim at the floor.
Set Ground: aim at the real ground slab if you set corners with the cabin already on 1. That height becomes G. The car stays put.
Register Panel: OUTSIDE wall buttons only. Never the inside panel.
Exclude landing: doorway slab stays put.
Corners name the car height G. Set Ground afterwards if that was not actually ground.

PASSENGER LIFT
3D cabin. Smallest interior 1 wide by 2 high. Need at least two shaft walls. Floor: any block. Walls and ceiling: plates and/or hatches.
Elevator doors at each landing. Cabin + landing doors on the same opening work as one set. A back set is optional and follows the others.
Locked outside doors call the car.
Cabin doors stay shut if there is no walkable floor outside (a drop or a wall). Outside landing doors are not locked by that check.
Inside panel: HOLD E and pick a floor. A tap of E does not send the car.
No inside panel: hold E on the cabin door while standing in the car. Closing the door does not send the car.
Players, vehicles, and loot in the cabin ride.

VEHICLE LIFT
Platform only. One garage or roll-up per landing - they stay put.
Pad at this floor: E opens that door. Pad elsewhere: E calls it, then the door opens on arrival.
Inside panel sits on the pad and rides. Do not register it. Hold E to pick a floor.
Do not build the pad out of Plate Double (pass-through). Use full cubes.
Truck and anything on the pad ride.

PLATES VS SHEETS
WALLS AND CEILING = PLATES or hatches (they ride). Floor = any block.
SHEETS, Plate Double, round ladders, and wall letters/numbers are pass-through: they stay at the landing. Use sheets around button panels.
Do not build cabin walls out of sheets or only the floor will move.

POWER
Wire any ONE registered outside panel on that lift. Other shafts cannot power it. Unregistered panels do nothing.

DOORS IN USE
The car will not leave while something is in the doorway. Pass-through blocks do not count as blocked.
Doors auto-close after 20 seconds realtime if the opening is clear.
Walk out while they are closing: they open again, then retry when you are clear.

FLOOR LETTER
Place a vanilla wall letter or number (G works) within 3 blocks of each outside door (elevator door, or garage / roll-up on a vehicle). They change to the floor the car is on, including while it is passing.
